Most prompts fail for one reason. The request is too vague.

You know roughly what you want. You haven't named the details that matter. The AI fills the gaps with assumptions, and the result misses.

The Flipped Interaction Pattern fixes this. The AI asks before it answers. It tests assumptions and builds context. Then it gives a precise, usable answer.

The prompt is simple: Ask me questions to achieve X. Keep asking until Y. Ask one question at a time. X is your goal. Y is when the AI knows enough.

Use it when context matters more than speed, or when you want personal output, not a template. Skip it for quick facts.

You trade speed for precision. The output is better because it is built on your real situation.

Full lesson: https://metaxis.io/blog/flipped-interaction-pattern-ai-asks-questions
